text: The boiler is making a loud banging noise when it comes on. It's still working and we've got hot water. Didn't do this before. 8 Carlton Street.

issues.summary_en: Boiler makes a loud banging noise when it starts; it still works and there is hot water.
issues.explanation: A new banging noise from a working boiler is a heating fault that should be checked soon, but heating and hot water still work.
